name: fastqa-mcp
description: MCP server with a QA mindset that lets an LLM drive and test web UI applications. Batched actions, built-in assertions, network call and status code recording, and record-and-replay with zero LLM calls.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test bench/unit.mjs bench/unit-review.mjs bench/unit-contract.mjs bench/unit-discovery.mjs bench/unit-upload.mjs bench/unit-facts.mjs bench/unit-docs.mjs bench/unit-registry.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node bench/e2e.mjs && node bench/export-check.mjs && node bench/qa-features.mjs && node bench/compat.mjs && node bench/observe.mjs && node bench/privacy.mjs && node bench/policy.mjs && node bench/safety.mjs && node bench/artifacts.mjs && node bench/review.mjs && node bench/cookies.mjs && node bench/upload.mjs && node bench/facts.mjs
